summary: Fairfax filed a 6-K attaching a press release announcing a C$650 million senior notes offering split into C$350 million 2037 notes priced at C$99.977 per C$100 principal with a 5.00% coupon and C$300 million 2056 notes priced at C$99.328 per C$100 principal with a 5.65% coupon. CIBC and TD are joint bookrunners. Notes are unsecured obligations, expected to close about November 10, 2026, with proceeds earmarked for refinancing debt or equity, potential acquisitions, and general corporate purposes. Watch redemption activity and any minority-interest buys.
